lines.text: The Israelites kill every male of Midian, including five kings, and also kill Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
Moses is angry with the officers and says the women caused unfaithfulness at Peor, so the plague struck Moab.

problems.problem: It has 22 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
Its wrong detail "a famine struck the congregation" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
